content.text: Navigation TogglePlayoffsTicketsTeamScheduleNews & MediaGame NightCommunityFansShopCloseOpen 76ERS TELEVISION NETWORK What channel is the Sixers game on? If you're wondering how to watch the Philadelphia 76ers, every contest throughout the 2025-26 NBA regular season will be shown live on NBC Sports Philadelphia along with broadcasters Kate Scott and Alaa Abdelnaby. Select games will also be found on national productions from ESPN, ABC, NBC | Peacock and Amazon Prime. Don't miss a single Tyrese Maxey fast break - Catch all of the action as Joel Embiid and Paul George look to bring South Philly its first NBA championship since 1983. Sixers fans can also subscribe to NBA League Pass to stream live games and studio shows, all season long, for one low price! SUBSCRIBE TO NBA LEAGUE PASS Log In To Watch NBC Sports Philadelphia NBC Sports Philadelphia delivers more than 500 sporting events per year, highlighted by live-game coverage of the 76ers, to fans throughout the Philadelphia region. NBC Sports Philadelphia also provides comprehensive sports news, analysis, commentary and original content across its television channels, including NBC Sports Philadelphia Plus, and digital media platforms, highlighted by NBCSportsPhiladelphia.com and the MyTeams app. Log In To Watch NBA on ABC Catch live NBA action and relive unforgettable classic games on ABC. Fans can also tune into expert studio coverage, featuring insights and analysis from renowned broadcasters like Mike Breen and Doris Burke, along with league-wide breakdowns and stories you won't want to miss.. Log In To Watch NBA TV Stream games live or watch iconic and classic basketball games on NBA TV. Plus, through NBA TV, fans can gain access to studio shows with commentary from leading insiders and former players, as well as in-depth analysis from around the league. Log In To Watch NBA on ESPN The 76ers are often featured in primetime as part of ESPN's NBA programming with Mike Breen and Doris Burke on the call. ESPN is also home to NBA Countdown, hosted by Mike Greenberg with Mike Wilbon and Stephen A. Smith, as well as NBA Today, hosted by Malika Andrews and featuring Kendrick Perkins and Chiney Ogwumike. Log In To Watch NBA on Peacock Stream select 76ers games live on Peacock as part of NBC’s new NBA coverage. Enjoy commentary from play-by-play voices like Mike Tirico and Noah Eagle, with in-game analysis from NBA greats like Reggie Miller, Jamal Crawford, and Grant Hill. Plus, pregame and halftime coverage with studio hosts Maria Taylor and Ahmed Fareed, alongside legends like Carmelo Anthony and Tracy McGrady. Log In To Watch NBA on Amazon Prime Watch exclusive Sixers games streaming only on Prime Video. Listen to play-by-play commentary from legends like Ian Eagle and Kevin Harlan, along with expert analysis from voices such as Stan Van Gundy, Candace Parker, and Dwyane Wade. Sideline reporters like Cassidy Hubbarth bring you closer to the action, while Taylor Rooks, Dirk Nowitzki, and Steve Nash deliver top-tier insights. Log In To Watch PHILLY57 Get your Coats on! PHILLY57 will air 15 home games for the Delaware Blue Coats, the NBA G League affiliate of the Philadelphia 76ers, throughout the 2024-25 season.
